bellview-myrtle-grove.name: Bellview and Myrtle Grove
bellview-myrtle-grove.note: Compare roof and system condition, buyer-based taxes and address-specific insurance for the Bellview or Myrtle Grove property. Check the actual NAS Pensacola or Corry work destination before comparing routes.

beulah.name: Beulah
beulah.note: For a Beulah resale or new build, compare association charges, property condition, builder terms where relevant, and the buyer's tax estimate. Use the actual work destination and travel schedule to compare routes.

cantonment.name: Cantonment
cantonment.note: For Cantonment, compare the actual house condition, acreage-related maintenance where applicable, association charges and the route to the assigned work location. Price alone does not describe the ownership budget.

cordova-park.name: Cordova Park
cordova-park.note: For a Cordova Park property, compare the inspection findings, roof and systems, planned repairs, buyer-based tax estimate and insurance quotes before choosing a budget.

crestview.name: Crestview
crestview.note: For Crestview, compare a resale and a new build using taxes after purchase, insurance, association costs and the actual Eglin or Duke work destination. A lower price does not remove the need for a route check.

destin.name: Destin
destin.note: For Destin, distinguish the costs of a house from a condominium's dues, assessments and insurance responsibilities. Confirm property-use restrictions and VA occupancy requirements if using that benefit.

east-hill.name: East Hill
east-hill.note: For East Hill, budget from the specific building's inspection, roof, systems and planned repairs. Obtain the buyer-based tax estimate and insurance quotes rather than inferring the costs from a neighborhood average.

east-pensacola-heights.name: East Pensacola Heights
east-pensacola-heights.note: For East Pensacola Heights, compare the parcel's flood information, quoted coverage and repair needs. A waterfront or water-view description does not establish the cost or availability of insurance.

ferry-pass.name: Ferry Pass
ferry-pass.note: For Ferry Pass, compare each property's condition and recurring expenses, then test the actual route to your assigned work location. Include association charges and planned repairs when applicable.

fort-walton-beach.name: Fort Walton Beach
fort-walton-beach.note: For Fort Walton Beach, compare the actual Eglin or Hurlburt work destination, roof and systems, buyer-based tax estimate and insurance quotes. Add condominium documents and dues if the property is in an association.

gulf-breeze.name: Gulf Breeze
gulf-breeze.note: For Gulf Breeze, check the route and any bridge dependence alongside parcel-specific flood information, insurance, maintenance and association costs. Compare the property rather than assuming every address has the same exposure.

mary-esther.name: Mary Esther
mary-esther.note: For Mary Esther, confirm the Hurlburt or other assigned work destination and compare insurance, roof and systems, buyer-based taxes and any association obligations for the exact address.

milton.name: Milton
milton.note: For Milton, compare the actual Whiting Field work destination, property condition, repair reserve, buyer-based taxes and coverage quotes. A resale and new construction can have different cash and recurring expenses.

navarre.name: Navarre
navarre.note: For Navarre, compare the actual assignment and travel corridor, association dues, parcel flood information and coverage quotes. NAS Pensacola and Hurlburt assignments can have different allowance entitlements even when considering the same home.

navy-point-warrington.name: Navy Point and Warrington
navy-point-warrington.note: For Navy Point and Warrington, check the property's flood information, roof and systems, repair needs, buyer-based taxes and actual route to NAS Pensacola or Corry Station.

niceville.name: Niceville
niceville.note: For Niceville, compare the actual Eglin work destination, property-specific taxes and insurance, association costs and the inspection findings. Add separate review of any waterfront exposure or condominium obligations.

pace.name: Pace
pace.note: For Pace, compare route conditions for your actual Whiting or other assignment, association charges, insurance, inspection findings and buyer-based taxes. Keep builder incentives separate from recurring ownership costs.

perdido-key.name: Perdido Key
perdido-key.note: For Perdido Key, compare condominium dues, assessments, reserves, insurance responsibilities and use restrictions, or the equivalent costs of a house. Confirm any VA project and occupancy requirements with the lender.

shalimar.name: Shalimar
shalimar.note: For Shalimar, compare the actual Eglin work location, property condition, parcel flood information, insurance and buyer-based taxes. Add waterfront maintenance or association obligations when they apply.
